75K8: Like the essence of sandalwood, He permeates her consciousness, and the Temple of the Tenth Gate is opened.
Dwelling (of the Lord) in the conscious she makes her sandal (make on the forehead) and the tenth gate her mansion.
5KYJ: The lamp of the Shabad is lit, and the Name of the Lord is her necklace. ||5||
She lights the lamp of the Word and has God's Name as her necklace.
FCP9: She is the most beautiful among women; upon her forehead she wears the Jewel of the Lord's Love.
Among women she is beautiful and on her brow she wears the jewel of Lord's love.
ET45: Her glory and her wisdom are magnificent; her love for the Infinite Lord is True.
Her celebrity and wisdom are beauteous and true is her love for the Infinite Lord.
9MNX: Other than her Beloved Lord, she knows no man. She enshrines love for the True Guru. ||6||
She knows no man except her Beloved. It is only the True Guru she enshrines love and affection for.
HXMX: Asleep in the darkness of the night, how shall she pass her life-night without her Husband?
But how shall she, who is asleep during the dark night, pass her night without her Beloved?
G7VE: Her limbs shall burn, her body shall burn, and her mind and wealth shall burn as well.
Yours limbs shall burn and your body shall and your mind and wealth shall burn as well;
BVC6: When the Husband does not enjoy His bride, then her youth passes away in vain. ||7||
When the Husband enjoys not wife, then her youth passes away in vain.
G02K: The Husband is on the Bed, but the bride is asleep, and so she does not come to know Him.
Her Spouse is on the couch but the wife being asleep has no knowledge of Him.
0SM7: While I am asleep, my Husband Lord is awake. Where can I go for advice?
While I sleep, my Beloved is awake. Whom should I go to consult?
39BK: The True Guru has led me to meet Him, and now I dwell in the Fear of God. O Nanak, His Love is always with me. ||8||2||
Nanak, the True Guru has taught me Lord's love, has caused me to meet Him and I abide in His fear.
CGK8: O Lord, You are Your Own Glorious Praise. You Yourself speak it; You Yourself hear it and contemplate it.
You, O Lord! art Your own excellences and You Yourself utterest, hearest and ponderest over them.
1P3H: You Yourself are the Jewel, and You are the Appraiser. You Yourself are of Infinite Value.
You Yourself are, the Name jewel and its assayer and You Yourself are of infinite value.
87J6: O True Lord, You are Honor and Glory; You Yourself are the Giver. ||1||
You, O True Lord! art honour and glory and Yourself the giver there-of.
FA31: O Dear Lord, You are the Creator and the Cause.
My honourable God! You are the Maker and Creator.
FPGK: If it is Your Will, please save and protect me; please bless me with the lifestyle of the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||
Save me as it pleases You, O God! and grant me the life of meditation. Pause.
NNLL: You Yourself are the flawless diamond; You Yourself are the deep crimson color.
You Yourself are the Pure gem and Yourself the colour of madder.
A1FD: You Yourself are the perfect pearl; You Yourself are the devotee and the priest.
You Yourself are the pure pearl and Yourself the devotee and inter-cessor.
96M4: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, You are praised. In each and every heart, the Unseen is seen. ||2||
By the Word of the Guru, the Invisible One is praised and seen in every heart.
P9M5: You Yourself are the ocean and the boat. You Yourself are this shore, and the one beyond.
You Yourself are the ocean and the ship and Yourself this shore and your yonder one.
532L: O All-knowing Lord, You are the True Way. The Shabad is the Navigator to ferry us across.
My Omniscient Lord! You are the right path and Your Name the navigator to ferry over.
Y6HX: One who does not fear God shall live in fear; without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness. ||3||
Know that dread is for those who fear not the Lord. Without the Guru there is pitch darkness.
5462: The Creator alone is seen to be Eternal; all others come and go.
The Creator alone is seen to be Eternal. All others continue coming and going.
SZW7: Only You, Lord, are Immaculate and Pure. All others are bound up in worldly pursuits.
You, O Lord! art by Yourself Pure. You have tied down and engaged others in secular pursuits.5
H07J: Those who are protected by the Guru are saved. They are lovingly attuned to the True Lord. ||4||
They, whom the Guru protects, are saved by cherishing love for the True Lord.

5SX6: Through the Shabad, they recognize the Dear Lord; through the Guru's Word, they are attuned to Truth.
Through the Word man recognises the adorable Lord and is imbued in the True through the Guru's sermon.
BK5R: Filth does not stick to the body of one who has secured a dwelling in his True Home.
Filth attaches not to the body of him, who has secured and abode in the True Home.
549L: When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, we obtain the True Name. Without the Name, who are our relatives? ||5||
If the Lord casts His merciful glance the True Name is procured. Without the Name who is man's kinsman?
YSG4: Those who have realized the Truth are at peace throughout the four ages.
They, who have recognised the Truth remain comfortable the four ages throughout.
VWYT: Subduing their egotism and desires, they keep the True Name enshrined in their hearts.
Having stilled their ego and desire they keep the True Name clasped to their heart.
2SS0: In this world, the only real profit is the Name of the One Lord; it is earned by contemplating the Guru. ||6||
The Name alone is the profit to be earned in this world. It is attained through the Guru given deliberation.
87Q7: Loading the Merchandise of the True Name, you shall gather in your profits forever with the Capital of Truth.
With the Capital of Truth, If the merchandise of the True Name is loaded, thus one always earns the profit.
GJD4: In the Court of the True One, you shall sit in truthful devotion and prayer.
By devotional meditation and true supplication man sits in Lord's True Court.
C8PK: Your account shall be settled with honor, in the Radiant Light of the Name of the Lord. ||7||
Man's account is settled with honour in the light of the Name of the Omnipresent Lord.
3U43: The Lord is said to be the Highest of the High; no one can perceive Him.
The Highest of the high the Lord is said to be. But He cannot be perceived by any one.
HS13: Wherever I look, I see only You. The True Guru has inspired me to see You.
Wherever I see, there I see You alone! The True Guru has caused me to behold You.
986Z: The Divine Light within is revealed, O Nanak, through this intuitive understanding. ||8||3||
Nanak, by divine insight, the mortal easily relishes the lord light within all.
L7XX: The fish did not notice the net in the deep and salty sea.
The fish did not pay attention to the net in the brackish and unfathomable sea.
D550: It was so clever and beautiful, but why was it so confident?
Why did the very clever and beautiful fish have so much confidence?
XMXH: By its actions it was caught, and now death cannot be turned away from its head. ||1||
Because of her doing (folly) she was caught. Death cannot be averted from over her head.
8QEM: O Siblings of Destiny, just like this, see death hovering over your own heads!
O Brother! do then deem death hovering over your head like this.
A50L: People are just like this fish; unaware, the noose of death descends upon them. ||1||Pause||
As is the fish, so is the man. Death's noose falls over him, unaware. pause.
MSWU: The whole world is bound by death; without the Guru, death cannot be avoided.
The entire world is bound by death. without the Guru, death is unchallengeable.
ERQW: Those who are attuned to Truth are saved; they renounce duality and corruption.
They, who are imbued with Truth and leave love of duality and sin are saved.
YDXA: I am a sacrifice to those who are found to be Truthful in the True Court. ||2||
I am a sacrifice to those, Who are found true at the True Court.
0FPU: Think of the hawk preying on the birds, and the net in the hands of the hunter.
As the hawk and the net in hunter's hands are to the birds, (so is death to the mortals).
YV7J: Those who are protected by the Guru are saved; the others are caught by the bait.
They, Whom the Guru preserves, are saved. The rest are ensnared with the bait.
TWMD: Without the Name, they are picked up and thrown away; they have no friends or companions. ||3||
Without God's Name, they are picked up and cast away friendless and comradeless.
02H6: God is said to be the Truest of the True; His Place is the Truest of the True.
God is said to be the Truest of the true, and True is the seat of the true Lord.
7UGK: Those who obey the True One-their minds abide in true meditation.
True meditation abides within the mind of those who obey the True One.
QCNY: Those who become Gurmukh, and obtain spiritual wisdom-their minds and mouths are known to be pure. ||4||
Pure are deemed the minds and mouths of those who through the Guru have obtained Divine Knowledge.
NZLM: Offer your most sincere prayers to the True Guru, so that He may unite you with your Best Friend.
Make supplication before the True Guru that he may unite you with the friend.
1GDA: Meeting your Best Friend, you shall find peace; the Messenger of Death shall take poison and die.
On meeting the friend, peace is obtained and myrmidons of death take poison and die.
0365: I dwell deep within the Name; the Name has come to dwell within my mind. ||5||
I abide in the Name, and the Name has come to abide within my mind.
FP07: Without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness; without the Shabad, understanding is not obtained.
Without the Guru there is complete darkness and sans God's Name understanding is not gained.
8XAQ: Through the Guru's Teachings, you shall be enlightened; remain absorbed in the Love of the True Lord.
By Guru's instruction division light shine and the mortal remains absorbed in true Lord's love.
11UT: Death does not go there; your light shall merge with the Light. ||6||
Death enters not there and man's light blends with the supreme Light.
CCR2: You are my Best Friend; You are All-knowing. You are the One who unites us with Yourself.
You are wise, you the uniter of man with Yourself.
5665: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, we praise You; You have no end or limitation.
Under Guru's instruction praise Him who has no limit and has not this or that end.
BYHY: Death does not reach that place, where the Infinite Word of the Guru's Shabad resounds. ||7||
Death reaches not there where there is the boundless word of the Guru.
0NZF: By the Hukam of His Command, all are created. By His Command, actions are performed.
By lord's fiat all are created and by his fiat they perform various functions.
V1XV: By His Command, all are subject to death; by His Command, they merge in Truth.
Under his command they are in the power of death and under his command they are absorbed in the True God.
NPBD: O Nanak, whatever pleases His Will comes to pass. Nothing is in the hands of these beings. ||8||4||
Nanak whatever pleases Him, that come to pass. Nothing is in the power of these creatures.
VKGA: If the mind is polluted, then the body is polluted, and the tongue is polluted as well.
If the mind is impure the body is impure the body is impure and impure the tongue.6

ZHZ8: With false mouths, people speak falsehood. How can they be made pure?
With false mouth man utters falsehood. How can he be pure?
V60A: Without the Holy Water of the Shabad, they are not cleansed. From the True One alone comes Truth. ||1||
Without the water of name (the soul) is not cleansed. the truth proceeds from the true One.
UVK4: O soul-bride, without virtue, what happiness can there be?
O Bride! what happiness is there without virtue.
S0H6: The Husband Lord enjoys her with pleasure and delight; she is at peace in the love of the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||Pause||
The beloved will enjoy (them) with pleasure and relish, who feel peace in the affection of the True name. Pause.
PRH9: When the Husband goes away, the bride suffers in the pain of separation,
If the Groom goes off the separated wife grieves,
C2YW: like the fish in shallow water, crying for mercy.
like the fish which bewails (cries for pity) bitterly in scanty water.
GXQ2: As it pleases the Will of the Husband Lord, peace is obtained, when He Himself casts His Glance of Grace. ||2||
When the spouse wills, He Himself favours His merciful Glance and the bride obtains peace.
5AV6: Praise your Husband Lord, together with your bridesmaids and friends.
With (in the company of) your female comrades and friend praise your consort.
WG4B: The body is beautified, and the mind is fascinated. Imbued with His Love, we are enraptured.
By beholding Him my body is beautiful, soul bewitched and I am imbrued with His love.
TTBR: Adorned with the Shabad, the beautiful bride enjoys her Husband with virtue. ||3||
The beautiful wife who is bedecked with the Name and is with merit, enjoys her Groom.
2XHH: The soul-bride is of no use at all, if she is evil and without virtue.
The evil and impious bride is of no use to the beloved
HX59: She does not find peace in this world or the next; she burns in falsehood and corruption.
She obtains peace neither at her parents(in this word) nor with in-laws(in the next world) and burns in falsehood and sin
3J23: Coming and going are very difficult for that bride who is abandoned and forgotten by her Husband Lord. ||4||
Hard is the coming and going of her who is deserted and for gotten by her husband.
3RMN: The beautiful soul-bride of the Husband Lord-by what sensual pleasures has she been doomed?
The beauteous wife of the husband for what sensuous pleasure she has been doomed
X5D1: She is of no use to her Husband if she babbles in useless arguments.
She who prattles (enter in to) useless wrangle is of no avail to the spouse.
1SAC: At the Door of His Home, she finds no shelter; she is discarded for seeking other pleasures. ||5||
Because of other relishes, she is discarded and obtains no shelter at her lord s door and mansion
2GZ9: The Pandits, the religious scholars, read their books, but they do not understand the real meaning.
The Brahmans read books but understand not the real meaning.
8BX0: They give instructions to others, and then walk away, but they deal in Maya themselves.
They instruct others and walk away themselves they trade in wealth
854R: Speaking falsehood, they wander around the world, while those who remain true to the Shabad are excellent and exalted. ||6||
They wander about the world talking falsehood while they who abide by the name are the best.
WTQH: There are so many Pandits and astrologers who ponder over the Vedas.
Many are the Pandits and astrologers who deliberate over vedas.
AWMT: They glorify their disputes and arguments, and in these controversies they continue coming and going.
They glorify disputes and strives and in controversies they continue coming and going.
2DUA: Without the Guru, they are not released from their karma, although they speak and listen and preach and explain. ||7||
Without the Guru they cannot be absolved of their action however much they may tell hear preach and expound.
CWBM: They all call themselves virtuous, but I have no virtue at all.
All call themselves virtuous but I posses no virtue.
H92G: With the Lord as her Husband, the soul-bride is happy; I, too, love that God.
Happy is the bride who has God as her spouse. I, too, love that lord of mine.
JY3R: O Nanak, through the Shabad, union is obtained; there is no more separation. ||8||5||
Nanak it is through the name that union with God is effected and separation occurs no more.
JE1W: You may chant and meditate, practice austerities and self-restraint, and dwell at sacred shrines of pilgrimage;
Man may perform recitations austerities and self restraint and dwell at places of pilgrimage.
7FUH: you may give donations to charity, and perform good deeds, but without the True One, what is the use of it all?
He may give donations and alms and do other good deeds but what does it avail him without the true being.
RG2M: As you plant, so shall you harvest. Without virtue, this human life passes away in vain. ||1||
As he sows so does he reap without virtue the human life passes away in vain.
GCW0: O young bride, be a slave to virtue, and you shall find peace.
O young bride happiness is obtained by being a slave to virtue.
S73J: Renouncing wrongful actions, following the Guru's Teachings, you shall be absorbed into the Perfect One. ||1||Pause||
She who under Guru s instruction eschews demerits gets absorbed in the perfect Lord. pause.
0WVF: Without capital, the trader looks around in all four directions.
Without capital the trader looks about in the four directions (in vain).
BTCQ: He does not understand his own origins; the merchandise remains within the door of his own house.
He understands not the real and the merchandise of God s Name remains undiscovered within his house's door.
9BC5: Without this commodity, there is great pain. The false are ruined by falsehood. ||2||
Without the Name commodity great is the anguish and the false man is ruined by falsehood.
A14S: One who contemplates and appraises this Jewel day and night reaps new profits.
He, who thoughtfully assays (meditates) the jewel of Name day and night reaps brand news profits.
74VD: He finds the merchandise within his own home, and departs after arranging his affairs.
He finds the commodity in his home and departs after fulfilling his affairs.
VZX3: So trade with the true traders, and as Gurmukh, contemplate God. ||3||
Trade with God's traders and through the Guru deliberate over the Lord.
ZD2X: In the Society of the Saints, He is found, if the Uniter unites us.
The Lord is obtained in the society of the saints, when Guru, the Uniter, unites man therewith.
QLSW: One whose heart is filled with His Infinite Light meets with Him, and shall never again be separated from Him.
He, within whose mind the infinite light of the Lord shines, meets Him and separates not again.
CH4S: True is his position; he abides in Truth, with love and affection for the True One. ||4||
True is the seat of such person, who abides in Truth and bears love and affection to the True Lord.
SQ55: One who understands himself finds the Mansion of the Lord's Presence within his own home.
They, who recognise their own self, find Lord's mansion in the good place of their home heart.
LET6: Imbued with the True Lord, Truth is gathered in.
Imbued with the True Name, the True One is obtained.7

LZ4W: God is known throughout the three worlds. True is the Name of the True One. ||5||
That Lord is known in the three worlds, True is the Name of the True Lord.
QYLF: The wife who knows that her Husband Lord is always with her is very beautiful.
Very beauteous is the wife who knows her Beloved to be within herself.
LSJR: The soul-bride is called to the Mansion of the His Presence, and her Husband Lord ravishes her with love.
Such bride is called to the palace and the Spouse enjoys her in love.
QZ5P: The happy soul-bride is true and good; she is fascinated by the Glories of her Husband Lord. ||6||
She is truly happy and virtuous wife, who is enamoured with the excellences of her darling Husband.
CUQZ: Wandering around and making mistakes, I climb the plateau; having climbed the plateau, I go up the mountain.
Going wrong and astray I ascend the plateau and having ascended the plateau I go up the mountain.
22YR: But now I have lost my way, and I am wandering around in the forest; without the Guru, I do not understand.
Having lost the way if I wander about in the forest etc; I shall not obtain the understanding (way) without the Guru.
SMQQ: If I wander around forgetting God's Name, I shall continue coming and going in reincarnation, over and over again. ||7||
If I walk about, forgetting God's Name I shall continue coming and going over and over again.
2WRB: Go and ask the travellers, how to walk on the Path as His slave.
Go and inquire from the wayfarers, who having become Lord's slaves, walk His way.
23M3: They know the Lord to be their King, and at the Door to His Home, their way is not blocked.
They deem God as their Monarch and they are not stopped at the door of His palace.
ABMW: O Nanak, the One is pervading everywhere; there is no other at all. ||8||6||
Nanak the One Lord is pervading every where. There is no other second what-so-ever.
EXYN: Through the Guru, the Pure One is known, and the human body becomes pure as well.
From the Guru, the Pure One is known and the body and human frame become pure.
0F2Q: The Pure, True Lord abides within the mind; He knows the pain of our hearts.
The Immaculate True Lord abides within the mind and He understands the heat's pang.
Q9C0: With intuitive ease, a great peace is found, and the arrow of death shall not strike you. ||1||
From Divine Knowledge extreme joy springs and death's arrow hits one not.
HYJR: O Siblings of Destiny, filth is washed away by bathing in the Pure Water of the Name.
O Brother! by bating in the pure water of God's Name no filth shall remain attached to you.
7BYG: You alone are Perfectly Pure, O True Lord; all other places are filled with filth. ||1||Pause||
You alone are perfectly pure, O True Lord! all other places are filled with dirt. Pause.
2BNX: The Temple of the Lord is beautiful; it was made by the Creator Lord.
God's palace is beauteous. The Creator has fashioned it.
0CM2: The sun and the moon are lamps of incomparably beautiful light. Throughout the three worlds, the Infinite Light is pervading.
Incomparable is the luster of the lamps of the Sun and the Moon. The infinite light of God is pervading the three worlds.
Y4X7: In the shops of the city of the body, in the fortresses and in the huts, the True Merchandise is traded. ||2||
In the body are shops, the cities and the fortresses, in which is the merchandise of the True Name to trade in.
P91L: The ointment of spiritual wisdom is the destroyer of fear; through love, the Pure One is seen.
The collyrium of Divine knowledge is the dread dispeller and it is through love that the Pure One is discerned.
JA1V: The mysteries of the seen and the unseen are all known, if the mind is kept centered and balanced.
The mortal comes to know all the hidden and the apparent, if he keeps his mind centered at One place.
4UA3: If one finds such a True Guru, the Lord is met with intuitive ease. ||3||
If man finds such a True Guru then, he easily, causes him to meet the Lord.
8PF9: He draws us to His Touchstone, to test our love and consciousness.
As the attrition is put on the touchstone (to test the gold) Lord assays (the spiritual) life of His creatures) with love and attention.
GQV3: The counterfeit have no place there, but the genuine are placed in His Treasury.
The Counterfeit find not a place and the genuine are but into the treasury.
MBTR: Let your hopes and anxieties depart; thus pollution is washed away. ||4||
Dispel your hope (desire) and anxiety; like this your filth shall be washed away.
7E5V: Everyone begs for happiness; no one asks for suffering.
Every one craves for happiness and none asks for misery.
0BS5: But in the wake of happiness, there comes great suffering. The self-willed manmukhs do not understand this.
Immense anguish comes in the wake of pleasures but the self-willed understand it not.
US0E: Those who see pain and pleasure as one and the same find peace; they are pierced through by the Shabad. ||5||
They, who deem weal and woe alike and pierce their soul with Name, obtain Divine Solace.
YQW4: The Vedas proclaim, and the words of Vyaasa tell us,
The recitation of Brahma's Vedas and Words (works) of Vyas proclaim that the silent sages,
MFPZ: that the silent sages, the servants of the Lord, and those who practice a life of spiritual discipline are attuned to the Naam, the Treasure of Excellence.
God's attendants and the strivers are imbued with the Name, the treasure of excellences.
EEF5: Those who are attuned to the True Name win the game of life; I am forever a sacrifice to them. ||6||
They, who are dyed with the True Name, win I am ever a sacrifice to them.
JZBT: Those who do not have the Naam in their mouths are filled with pollution; they are filthy throughout the four ages.
They, within whose mount Lord's Name is not, are brimful with pollution and remain filthy, the four ages through.
G0FJ: Without loving devotion to God, their faces are blackened, and their honor is lost.
They who are bereft of Lord's love and devotion lose honour and their faces are blackened.
59WV: Those who have forgotten the Naam are plundered by evil; they weep and wail in dismay. ||7||
They, who have forgotten the Name, bewail defrauded by sin.
BSJ1: I searched and searched, and found God. In the Fear of God, I have been united in His Union.
By seeking and searching I have found the Lord. Through Lord's fear I have met with His union.
M6F4: Through self-realization, people dwell within the home of their inner being; egotism and desire depart.
By recognising his ownself man abides in his own home and his ego and desire depart.
P0DT: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Name of the Lord are immaculate and radiant. ||8||7||
Nanak, blotless and exonerated are they, who are imbued with the Name of God.
XBGP: Listen, O deluded and demented mind: hold tight to the Guru's Feet.
Hear you O my deluded and demented mind! take to the Feet of the Guru.
ZCY0: Chant and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; death will be afraid of you, and suffering shall depart.
Remember God and meditate on the Name, (by so doing) the god of death is afraid, and woe departs.
G4DE: The deserted wife suffers terrible pain. How can her Husband Lord remain with her forever? ||1||
The unfortunate wife faces untold hardships, How can her Spouse remain for ever with her?8

UDYL: O Siblings of Destiny, I have no other place to go.
O Brother! I have no other place.
LWYQ: The Guru has given me the Treasure of the Wealth of the Naam; I am a sacrifice to Him. ||1||Pause||
The Guru has given me the Treasure of the Wealth of God's Name, I am devout to him. Pause.
VMV4: The Guru's Teachings bring honor. Blessed is He-may I meet and be with Him!
By Guru's instruction comes honour. Hail to him, (the Guru) I associate with him.
TSJU: Without Him, I cannot live, even for a moment. Without His Name, I die.
Without Him I cannot live even for a moment. Without His Name I die.
FM75: I am blind-may I never forget the Naam! Under His Protection, I shall reach my true home. ||2||
May, I the blind, forget not God's Name. Placed under His protection I shall reach my Home.
NR5K: Those chaylaas, those devotees, whose spiritual teacher is blind, shall not find their place of rest.
The disciples, whose religious guide is blind, find no place.
W2U5: Without the True Guru, the Name is not obtained. Without the Name, what is the use of it all?
Sans the True Guru Lord's Name is not obtained. Without the Name what is the aim of human Life?
H437: People come and go, regretting and repenting, like crows in a deserted house. ||3||
Man regrets his coming and going like the crow visiting a deserted house.
9WNY: Without the Name, the body suffers in pain; it crumbles like a wall of sand.
Without the Name the body wirthes in pain like the wall of nitrous salts.
M6Z9: As long as Truth does not enter into the consciousness, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is not found.
As long as truth enters not man's mind till then he gains not Lord's presence.
68VB: Attuned to the Shabad, we enter our home, and obtain the Eternal State of Nirvaanaa. ||4||
Being imbued with the Name in his home, mortal obtains eternal status of salvation.
FJK5: I ask my Guru for His Advice, and I follow the Guru's Advice.
I make inquiry from my Guru and do the deeds according to his directive.
GWUW: With the Shabads of Praise abiding in the mind, the pain of egotism is burnt away.
The pain of self-conceit is burnt down, if the praises of the Lord abide in man's mind.
A4PT: We are intuitively united with Him, and we meet the Truest of the True. ||5||
It is through Divine knowledge that union is accomplished and the mortal meets with the Immortal True.
YZJK: Those who are attuned to the Shabad are spotless and pure; they renounce sexual desire, anger, selfishness and conceit.
They, who are imbued with the Divine Word are pure. They renounce lust, wrath and pride.
66MA: They sing the Praises of the Naam, forever and ever; they keep the Lord enshrined within their hearts.
For ever and aye, they sing the praises of the Name and keep God clasped to their heart.
9034: How could we ever forget Him from our minds? He is the Support of all beings. ||6||
Within our mind why should we forget Him who is the mainstay of all the beings?
FJTG: One who dies in the Shabad is beyond death, and shall never die again.
He who dies of the Divine word gets immune from death and dies not, again a second time.
G898: Through the Shabad, we find Him, and embrace love for the Name of the Lord.
From Guru's instruction love for God's Name is obtained and the Lord is attained to.
2JWJ: Without the Shabad, the world is deceived; it dies and is reborn, over and over again. ||7||
Without Lord's Name the world has gone astray and suffers transmigration over and over again.
3266: All praise themselves, and call themselves the greatest of the great.
Every one lauds himself and deems himself the greatest of the great.
63DT: Without the Guru, one's self cannot be known. By merely speaking and listening, what is accomplished?

RNHZ: O Nanak, one who realizes the Shabad does not act in egotism. ||8||8||
Nanak, if man recognises the Lord, he takes not pride on himself.

F4WR: She does not enjoy the pleasure of His Bed; without her Husband, her ornaments are absurd.
She enjoys not the pleasure of the bed of her Spouse without whom absurd is her ornamentation.

The unfortunate bride faces great misery. Her Spouse reposes not on the couch of her home.
6F9L: O mind, meditate on the Lord, and find peace.
O my mind! meditate on the Pervading God to obtain peace.

Through deep love and affection the wife, assuredly, enjoys the stead of her Beloved.

8CT9: Through Truth, meet your Husband Lord, O soul-bride. Enchanted by your Husband, enshrine love for Him.
Through Truth O lady! meet you your Spouse and by enshrining affection for Him, you shall be enamoured of your Beloved.
SLB8: Your mind and body shall blossom forth in Truth. The value of this cannot be described.
Her worth cannot be told (appraised.). With the True Lord her soul and body shall bloom.
E7XD: The soul-bride finds her Husband Lord in the home of her own being; she is purified by the True Name. ||3||
The Husband loved bride, who is sanctified by the True Name, obtains God, as her Spouse, in her very home.

Like the threaded pearls forming a necklace round the neck the two are woven into one texture.

Peace ensues by seeing the support of the Name in the society of the saints, through the Guru.

In a moment man is born, in a moment he dies, in a moment he comes and in a moment he goes.

Death agonises not him who recognises the Word and merges in it.9

The unweighable Lord cannot be weighted. By mere talk He cannot be attained to.

After having god recorded their maintenance, the merchants and traders have come in this world.
TYB8: Those who practice Truth reap the profits, abiding in the Will of God.
They, who practise truth and abide by God's will, reap the profit.

By the merchandise of truth, they meet the Guru, who has not even an iota of avarice.
Z214: As Gurmukh, they are weighed and measured, in the balance and the scales of Truth.
With the balance of Truth and the weight of Truth the Exalted Guru measures and causes others to measure.
ZJH1: The enticements of hope and desire are quieted by the Guru, whose Word is True.
Hope and desire, which allure all, are stilled by the Guru, whose word is True.
ZLDZ: He Himself weighs with the scale; perfect is the weighing of the Perfect One. ||7||
He Himself weights in the scale. Perfect is the weigthing of the perfect One.
4WPG: No one is saved by mere talk and speech, nor by reading loads of books.
By mere talk and say we are not saved nor by reading loads of books.
GANR: The body does not obtain purity without loving devotion to the Lord.
Without God's service and affection, purity of the body is not procured.
04E0: O Nanak, never forget the Naam; the Guru shall unite us with the Creator. ||8||9||
If man forgets not the Name, O Nanak! the Guru shall unite him with the Creator.
6W5S: Meeting the Perfect True Guru, we find the jewel of meditative reflection.
If we meet the Perfect True Guru, we obtain the jewel of Thought.
9CP9: Surrendering our minds to our Guru, we find universal love.
By tendering our mind to our Guru, we attain to the love of the omnipresent Lord.
0ZBS: We find the wealth of liberation, and our demerits are erased. ||1||
We obtain the wealth of Salvation, which is the obliterator of demerits,
6WW1: O Siblings of Destiny, without the Guru, there is no spiritual wisdom.
O Brother! without the Guru, Divine Awakening is not gained.
H9GK: Go and ask Brahma, Naarad and Vyaas, the writer of the Vedas. ||1||Pause||
Let some one go and inquire from Brahma, Narad and Vyas, the writer of Vedas. Pause.
LZST: Know that from the vibration of the Word, we obtain spiritual wisdom and meditation. Through it, we speak the Unspoken.
Know that from Guru's Word, Divine comprehension and meditation are obtained and that He makes man utter the Unutterable One.
KMTN: He is the fruit-bearing Tree, luxuriantly green with abundant shade.
The Guru is the green, fruit bearing tree with abundant shade.
BMSW: The rubies, jewels and emeralds are in the Guru's Treasury. ||2||
The rubies, jewels and emeralds these are in Guru's treasure.
174E: From the Guru's Treasury, we receive the Love of the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord.
From the Guru's storehouse do we receive the love of the immaculate Name.
66R3: We gather in the True Merchandise, through the Perfect Grace of the Infinite.
Through the perfect grace of the infinite Lord we amass the merchandise of the True Name.
14MX: The True Guru is the Giver of peace, the Dispeller of pain, the Destroyer of demons. ||3||
The True Guru is the giver of peace, the eraser of anguish and the destroyer of the demon of evil deeds.

The fearful ocean of the world is arduous and dreadful. It has neither a shore nor the yonder end.
D6F8: There is no boat, no raft, no oars and no boatman.
It has no boat no raft, no pole and no boatsman.
FNQZ: The True Guru is the only boat on this terrifying ocean. His Glance of Grace carries us across. ||4||
The True Guru is the only ship on the fearful sea whose merciful glance takes men across.
L4V0: If I forget my Beloved, even for an instant, suffering overtakes me and peace departs.
If I forget the Beloved, for an instant, suffering overtakes me and comfort departs.
P3BK: Let that tongue be burnt in flames, which does not chant the Naam with love.
Burnt be that flammable tongue, which repeats not God's Name with love.
V9G8: When the pitcher of the body bursts, there is terrible pain; those who are caught by the Minister of Death regret and repent. ||5||
When the pitcher (body) bursts man writhes in great pain and grieves when caught by death's minister.
LWYP: Crying out, "Mine! Mine!", they have departed, but their bodies, their wealth, and their wives did not go with them.
Men have departed crying "me my and mine" and their bodies, wealth and wives accompanied them not.
4UDD: Without the Name, wealth is useless; deceived by wealth, they have lost their way.
Without the Name, riches are in vain, One loses his way deluded by mammon.
UVY7: So serve the True Lord; become Gurmukh, and speak the Unspoken. ||6||
Through the Guru serve the True Lord and describe the Ineffable Master.
M868: Coming and going, people wander through reincarnation; they act according to their past actions.
Man comes(is born), goes (dies) and is goaded into existences. He acts in accordance with his past actions.
E0S1: How can one's pre-ordained destiny be erased? It is written in accordance with the Lord's Will.
How can the pre-natal writ be obliterated, when the writ is written under Lord's Will?
E796: Without the Name of the Lord, no one can be saved. Through the Guru's Teachings, we are united in His Union. ||7||
Without God's Name the mortal cannot be saved. By Guru's instruction he unites with Lord's union.
0DUH: Without Him, I have no one to call my own. My soul and my breath of life belong to Him.
I have no one to call my own without Him, to whom belong my soul and life.
S9CJ: May my egotism and possessiveness be burnt to ashes, and my greed and egotistical pride consigned to the fire.
Burnt to ashes be you, O my ego and worldly love! May my avarice and egotism be consigned to fire.
Y8ED: O Nanak, contemplating the Shabad, the Treasure of Excellence is obtained. ||8||10||
Nanak, by deliberating over the Name the Lord Treasure of Excellences, is obtained.
GEMG: O mind, love the Lord, as the lotus loves the water.
O my mind! entertain such an affection for God as the lotus has for water.
656S: Tossed about by the waves, it still blossoms with love.
It is dashed down with the waves but still it blooms in love.
LH00: In the water, the creatures are created; outside of the water they die. ||1||
In water God did create the creatures,. their death occurs without water.0

AGRQ: O mind, how can you be saved without love?
O My Mind! how shall you be delivered without love?

In the hearts of the pious persons the Lord dwells. To them He gives the treasure of His devotional service. Pause.
D81F: O mind, love the Lord, as the fish loves the water.
O my mind! enshrine such love for God as the fish has for water.

The more the water, the more the happiness and the greater the peace of mind, body and frame (the fish feels).
GTZY: Without water, she cannot live, even for an instant. God knows the suffering of her mind. ||2||
Without water she cannot live even for an instant. The Lord knows the suffering of her mind.

O my mind! cherish such an affection for God as the pied-cuckoo has for the rain.

If God's grace dawns, he shall have the raindrops, otherwise in view of his past actions he gives his head.

O my mind! such love do you bear for God as the water bears for milk.

The water added to milk itself bears the heat and allows not the milk to be consumed.
A1J2: God unites the separated ones with Himself again, and blesses them with true greatness. ||4||
God Himself unites the separated and grants true greatness.
PSKS: O mind, love the Lord, as the chakvee duck loves the sun.
O my mind! hear such love of God as the sheldrake has for the sun.

Even for an instant and a moment she slumbers not you has no sleep. (The sun, though) far off, she deems near at hand.

Understanding comes not to the perverse person. To the pious person the Lord is ever close at hand.

The Self-willed make calculations. But it is only what the Creator does that comes to pass.
A7BB: His Value cannot be estimated, even though everyone may wish to do so.
His worth cannot be ascertained even though all men may desire it.
6BHQ: Through the Guru's Teachings, it is revealed. Meeting with the True One, peace is found. ||6||
By guru's instruction it is however revealed. By meeting the True Lord peace is obtained.

If the True Guru be met the true love shall bot sunder.
3U8K: Obtaining the wealth of spiritual wisdom, the understanding of the three worlds is acquired.
By obtaining the wealth of Divine Knowledge the insight into the three worlds is acquired.

If one becomes a customer of merit he forgets not the pure Name then.

The birds which pecked at the place of the pool have played and gone away.

In a moment or a trice the mortal is to depart. His joyful play is for to-day or to-tomorrow.

He whom You unitest, unites with You and takes his place in the True arena.

Without the Guru love springs not and filth of ego departs not.

He who recognises God within himself and is pierced through with His Name is satisfied.

When man understands his own-self through the Guru what more is left for him to do or to get done?

Why speak of uniting with the Lord those who are already in union with Him. They are satisfied by receiving the Name.

The perverse obtain not understanding. Separated from God they bear strokes.

For Nanak, except of Lord's mansion's gate, there is no other second shelter.

The led-astray self-willed person goes amiss. The deluded one has no place of rest.

Without the Guru none shows the right path. The spiritually blind continue coming and going.

Having lost the wealth of Divine Comprehension, man departs defrauded and pillaged.
SUQH: O Baba, Maya deceives with its illusion.
O Brother! mammon deludes with it's illusion.

The discarded bride who is deluded by doubt, rests not in the embrace of her Beloved. Pause.

In suspicion her mind wavers, and missing the path she ascends the table lands and mountains.

How can she, who is separated from the primal Being meet Him? Duped by egotism, she bewails.1
NT2U: The Guru unites the separated ones with the Lord again, through the love of the Delicious Name of the Lord.
